"I hated every second of it. I wanted to vomit. I wanted to yell. I felt like Prometheous getting his liver eaten by that jackass crow. It is now 6:18 as I regale you with this tale. The taste has since faded and I have recovered. So yeah, the moral of this thread is coffee sucks."

"just for some caffeine? And for what? To have a normal functioning brain? I lived a whole 19 years without needing one of those, why start now? But no, this wasn't about my brain anymore, this was about my strength of will. At 5 a.m. I finally, finally drink the last quarter."

"the most disgusting bitterness I've ever tasted. It's worse than the coating of a Switch cartridge, it's worse than alcohol, it's worse than a dirty cheeto I found on the floor of a public park, don't ask. I was questioning my life at this point, am I really torturing myself-"

"After a 30 second break I go for the next 1/4th. It wasn't easy, but I was half way there, I couldn't stop now. I can already feel my stomach churning from this poison. Did you know coffe can act as a laxative? Well now you do. I drink another quarter. My mouth is filled with-"

"lack of those sweet succulent white crystals. I was at a loss. I had already put away the milk, and when I thought about it, adding more volume would only add to my torture. I had only 2 choices, dump it or down it. And Mama didn't raise no coward."

"So I do what many would call idiotic, but some would call brave, and attempt to down about 12 fluid ounces of actual poison in one go. I failed, only getting 1/4th in before I was gagging... This was gonna be harder than I thought."

"I pour my coffee into my favorite ahegao mug, a birthday gift from my sisters, and I pour in some milk. My usual ratio is 50/50 milk to coffee. But I only put about 30/70. I felt daring, I wanted to try and get used to the bitterness. But I open the cabinet, and find a distinct-"

"Without caffeine I'd get too bored and restless the whole time. So I get up, go to my kitchen, careful not to wake my dad who's sleeping on the living room couch, and start making coffee. But get this shit guys, this is why I'm making this lengthy tweet; we had no more sugar..."
